scope: Physical 64x72 RGB565 offscreen solid-triangle batch throughput including Core0 scene preparation/submission/polling; not gameplay or display FPS
identity: Private firmware ABI 1 and FPGA GRX1 accepted at runtime; staged boot hash is a source hash, not a live firmware readback
checks: Five preflight scenes (clear, solid, additive, texture, alpha), final timed-scene pixels, matching retired tokens, timer calibration within 1%, successful CLOSE
timing: Timed interval begins before first measured submit and ends at last retirement; excludes preflight scenes, final readback and startup/close
limits: No game rendering or display presentation
